Objective: Acquire data to process global temperature anomalies

## Project Software Environment

```{r}
#| label: software-versions
quarto_version <- system2("quarto", "--version", stdout = TRUE)[1]
# Update manually when Positron is upgraded
positron_version <- "2026.6.0"

software_versions <- data.frame(
  category = c(
    "Platform", "Platform", "Platform",
    "Package", "Package", "Package",
    "Package", "Package", "Package",
    "Package", "Package", "Package"
  ),
  software = c(
    "R","Quarto","Positron",
    "tidyverse","gt","R.utils",
    "rnaturalearth","sf","ncdf4",
    "patchwork","pals","viridisLite"
  ),
  version = c(
    as.character(getRversion()),
    quarto_version,
    positron_version,
    as.character(packageVersion("tidyverse")),
    as.character(packageVersion("gt")),
    as.character(packageVersion("R.utils")),
    as.character(packageVersion("rnaturalearth")),
    as.character(packageVersion("sf")),
    as.character(packageVersion("ncdf4")),
    as.character(packageVersion("patchwork")),
    as.character(packageVersion("pals")),
    as.character(packageVersion("viridisLite"))
  ),
  used_in = c(
    "01–03","01–03","Development",
    "01–03","01–03","01",
    "01","01–03","02",
    "03","03","03"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: software-versions-table
library(gt)
software_versions |>
  gt(
    groupname_col = "category"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    software = "Software",

  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",

  ) |>

    )

```

## Initialization

### Libraries

```{r}
#| label: libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(R.utils)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(sf)
})
```

### Directories

```{r}
#| label: directories

dir_raw <- file.path("data", "raw")
dir.create(dir_raw, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dir_transformed <- file.path("data", "transformed")
dir.create(dir_transformed, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dir_archive <- file.path("data", "archive")
dir.create(dir_archive, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

### URls

```{r}
#| label: URLs
url_csv <- paste0("https://data.giss.nasa.gov/", "gistemp/tabledata_v4/")
url_netcdf <- paste0("https://data.giss.nasa.gov/", "pub/gistemp/")
```

### Catalog

```{r}
#| label: catalog
file_catalog <-
  tibble(
    dataset = c(
      "Global Monthly Temperature",
      "Northern Hemisphere Monthly Temperature",
      "Southern Hemisphere Monthly Temperature",
      "Latitude Zone Annual Temperature",
      "Global Gridded Monthly Temperature"
    ),
    source = "NASA GISS",
    format = c(
      "CSV",
      "CSV",
      "CSV",
      "CSV",
      "NetCDF"
    ),
    filename = c(
      "GLB.Ts+dSST.csv",
      "NH.Ts+dSST.csv",
      "SH.Ts+dSST.csv",
      "ZonAnn.Ts+dSST.csv",
      "gistemp1200_GHCNv4_ERSSTv5.nc"
    ),
    source_url = c(
      url_csv,
      url_csv,
      url_csv,
      url_csv,
      url_netcdf
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    local_path = file.path(
      dir_raw,
      filename
    )
  )
```

## Download temperature anomalies

### Download csv files

```{r}
#| label: download-csv

for (i in seq_len(nrow(file_catalog))) {

  if (file_catalog$format[[i]] == "CSV") {

    filename <- file_catalog$filename[[i]]
    source_url <- file_catalog$source_url[[i]]

    download_path <- paste0(
      source_url,
      filename
    )

    latest_path <- file.path(
      dir_raw,
      filename
    )

    archive_path <- file.path(
      dir_archive,
      filename
    )

    download.file(
      url = download_path,
      destfile = latest_path,
      mode = "wb",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    file.copy(
      from = latest_path,
      to = archive_path,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )

    message(
      "Updated: ",
      filename
    )
  }
}
```

### Download netCDF file

```{r}
#| label: download-netCDF

for (i in seq_len(nrow(file_catalog))) {
  if (file_catalog$format[[i]] == "NetCDF") {
    filename <- file_catalog$filename[[i]]
    source_url <- file_catalog$source_url[[i]]
    download_path <- paste0(
      source_url,
      filename,
      ".gz"
    )
    latest_path <- file.path(
      dir_raw,
      filename
    )
    archive_path <- file.path(
      dir_archive,
      paste0(
        filename,
        ".gz"
      )
    )
    temporary_path <- paste0(
      archive_path,
      ".download"
    )
    download.file(
      url = download_path,
      destfile = temporary_path,
      mode = "wb",
      quiet = FALSE
    )
    file.rename(
      from = temporary_path,
      to = archive_path
    )
    R.utils::gunzip(
      filename = archive_path,
      destname = latest_path,
      overwrite = TRUE,
      remove = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

### Acquire coastline

```{r}
#| label: acquire-coastline
path_coastline <- file.path(dir_raw,"global-coastline.gpkg")
coastline_sf <- rnaturalearth::ne_download(
  scale = 10,
  type = "coastline",
  category = "physical",
  returnclass = "sf"
)
sf::st_write(
  coastline_sf,
  path_coastline,
  layer = "coastline",
  delete_dsn = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)
file_catalog <-
  bind_rows(
    file_catalog,
    tibble(
      dataset = "Global Coastline",
      source = "Natural Earth",
      format = "GeoPackage",
      filename = basename(
        path_coastline
      ),
      source_url =
        "https://www.naturalearthdata.com/",
      local_path = path_coastline
    )
  )
```

### Update catalog

```{r}
#| label: update-catalog
file_catalog <-
  file_catalog |>
  mutate(
    directory = dirname(
      local_path
    ),
    acquisition_datetime = format(
      file.info(local_path)$mtime,
      "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"
    ),
    file_size_kb = round(
      file.info(local_path)$size / 1024,
      0
    )
  )
```
